instruction: Place the text 'WEB' on the slide and change its background to blue.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a note 'WEB' to the slide and changing background color to blue (RGB: 0, 0, 255). The evaluator checks both the note text (case-sensitive) and the background color. Custom getter extracts both note text and background RGB from the PPTX file, and custom metric compares them with expected values (50% score for note match, 50% for color match).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both instruction requirements: note text 'WEB' and blue background color RGB(0, 0, 255)

Getter correctly extracts background RGB color and converts RGBColor objects to tuples at lines 45 and 50 using (rgb_color[0], rgb_color[1], rgb_color[2])
Metric performs case-sensitive exact match for note text, which is correct per the hint 'input is case sensitive' (metrics/impress.py:21)
Metric properly handles list-to-tuple conversion for expected_rgb at lines 30-33 and compares correctly at line 35
Coverage is complete: 50% score for note match, 50% for background color match
